name: Minauros
title: Minauros: The Third Layer
description: Minauros is the third layer of the Nine Hells, an endless bog of vile pollution, slime, and acid rain.
wiki: Minauros is a dismal realm of swamps and bogs where the greedy Mammon rules from the Sinking City. The environment is constantly shifting and sinking, reflecting the treacherous nature of its ruler.
